description: The new ungated-list allocation branch appends lists instead of the constructed wildcard keys.
trigger: Call allocate_transformer with g=None and list-valued u and d.
expected_behavior: Build a strategy keyed by wildcard projection names and expand it to concrete slice keys.
actual_behavior: keys += [m] stores each projection list; the strategy dictionary comprehension then attempts to use an unhashable list as a key.

verification.limits: Reach is conditional on supplying ungated lists.
